note: OFFLINE FIXTURE for the flood containment standing check (SS-W17, P-45). Every ring, every sample point and every PostGIS verdict here is REAL, dumped read-only from production txgio_parcel and tx_fema_nfhl_flood_zone. The offline grade runs the JS implementation against the PostGIS verdicts recorded here, so the CI job is a genuine cross-implementation divergence test rather than one implementation replaying against itself. atomSamplePoint is null on every case because no flood-hazard-fact atom in the store carries a stamp yet; that is why the CI job grades the CODE legs only and the live run grades all four.
curationRule: deliberately NOT a head-of-list sample. 120 parcels whose vertex-mean centroid falls OUTSIDE their own ring (the violation class this check exists for) plus 180 contained parcels drawn at a fixed stride across the remainder. A fixture of well-behaved squares would go green on a build that had broken the check.

population.countingRule: over the 5,750 PLANNABLE parcels of the 6,000-feature Bastrop 48021 read; not a county-complete figure

expectedContainment.note: asserted by the fixture test, so a change that silently stops detecting violations fails rather than passing with a smaller number
